title: Debris-flow potential streams (土石流潛勢溪流資料)
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Agency of Rural Development and Soil and Water Conservation (農業部農村發展及水土保持署)
description: The official list of streams designated as debris-flow potential streams, each with the county, township and village it mainly lies in. Counted per township. A township that is not in the list has no designated stream.

title: Monuments register (文資局古蹟), national monuments
publisher: Ministry of Culture, Bureau of Cultural Heritage (文化部文化資產局)
description: The national register of monuments (古蹟) designated under the Cultural Heritage Preservation Act, with each site's coordinates, address and announcements. Only the national monuments (國定古蹟, designated by the Ministry of Culture) are kept; a monument's designation year is the year of its earliest designation announcement in the register.
used_for: Landmark wonders: position, name, designation year

title: Airport traffic by airport (民航運輸各機場營運量－按機場分)
publisher: Civil Aviation Administration, MOTC (交通部民用航空局)
description: Aircraft movements, passengers (人次: arriving plus departing, transit included) and cargo in metric tons at each civil airport, by year since 1952 and by month for the current year (CAA civil aviation statistics, table 3). The newest complete calendar year and the year before it are used.
used_for: Airports: passengers, cargo tonnage, hub class
vintage: 交通部民用航空局 民航運輸各機場營運量，2025 年

title: Use of housing units by township, 2020 Population and Housing Census (各鄉鎮市區住宅使用情形)
publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (主計總處), Executive Yuan
description: Housing units in each township at the 2020 census (reference date 8 November 2020): homes somebody usually lives in, and homes nobody usually lives in (used now and then by the owner, used for something else such as an office or store room, or not in use). Taiwan publishes no home-ownership rate by township; the share of homes that are lived in is shown in its place.

title: Manpower Survey, 2025 annual report: employed people by industry and county
publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (主計總處), Executive Yuan
description: Annual averages for 2025: employed people (thousands) in each of the 19 industry sections, counted where they live (table 33), and the unemployment rate (table 26), for the 20 counties and cities of the Taiwan area. Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered by the survey, so their jobs are null.
used_for: Food, Production, Science and Culture yields (workers by industry)

title: Manpower Survey, 2025 annual report: employed people by occupation and county
publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (主計總處), Executive Yuan
description: Annual averages for 2025: employed people (thousands, rounded to the nearest thousand) in seven occupation groups, counted where they live (table 34), for the 20 counties and cities of the Taiwan area. Craft workers, machine operators and labourers are one column in the report. Kinmen and Lienchiang are not covered by the survey.

title: Industry and Commerce Census 2021: enterprise units by county
publisher: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (主計總處), Executive Yuan
description: Gross value added (全年生產毛額, NT$) in 2021 of all industry and service enterprises, by the county where each enterprise is registered. Used as Gold because Taiwan has no official county GDP. It leaves out agriculture and government, and a firm with sites in several counties counts at its seat.
vintage: Industry and Commerce Census 2021 (DGBAS), enterprise units

title: Actual-price registration of real-estate sales (不動產買賣實價登錄批次資料)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Land Administration (內政部地政司)
description: Every registered sale of real estate, published by season. The median total price and the median price per square metre of home sales in each township over four seasons (114S4 - 115S3, ROC year and quarter) are computed from it. Sales of existing homes registered in the seasons listed: the transaction includes a building (建物), its main use is residential (住家用), its type is a walk-up flat, mid-rise or high-rise flat, townhouse or studio, the total price is above zero, and the registry's remark does not flag a sale between relatives, employees or co-owners. Pre-sale contracts, land-only and parking-only sales are excluded.

title: Mobile broadband speed measurements by township (行動通訊速率量測)
publisher: Ministry of Digital Affairs (數位發展部)
description: Download and upload speeds of each mobile operator measured at fixed points in 2023, averaged per township by the Ministry. The lens shows the mean download speed over the operators measured in a township. Townships without measurement points are not in the file.

title: Children of new immigrants in elementary and junior high schools by township; elementary schools
publisher: Ministry of Education, Department of Statistics (教育部統計處)
description: Pupils of elementary and junior high schools who have a parent from abroad or from mainland China, Hong Kong or Macao (新住民子女), by the township of the school, and the pupils of every elementary school, school year 2025-26. The share of elementary pupils with a new-immigrant parent stands in for a foreign-born share, which is not published by township.

title: University project funding (校務資訊公開平臺 研1), enrolment and directory
publisher: Ministry of Education (教育部): Department of Higher Education and Department of Statistics
description: For every university and college: the project funding it received in a year from all sponsors (government, business and others: research, industry cooperation and other commissioned projects, in New Taiwan dollars), students with formal enrolment on 15 October (all levels, day and evening), and its registered address. Project funding is what schools report to the ministry's disclosure platform; it is not a survey of R&D spending.
used_for: University wonders: ranking, funding, enrolment, township

title: Income tax returns by county: median income per tax unit (綜稅總所得各縣市申報統計分析表)
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Fiscal Information Agency (財政部財政資訊中心)
description: Median total income (總所得) per tax unit (a filer with spouse and dependants) on the income tax returns filed in each county, the newest income year in the dataset. Not household income: tax-exempt income and government transfers are not included, and people who need not file are not counted.
used_for: Median income of cities, counties and the nation

title: Individual income tax statistics by township and village (綜合所得稅所得總額統計分析表 165-9)
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Fiscal Information Agency (財政部財政資訊中心)
description: Assessed individual income tax returns by township: number of tax units (a filer with spouse and dependants), total income, and the mean, median and quartiles of income per tax unit. Income that is tax-exempt or taxed separately, and government transfers, are not included, and people who need not file are not counted. The newest income year in the dataset is used.

title: Medical staff of hospitals and clinics by township (醫院人力統計、診所人力統計)
publisher: Ministry of Health and Welfare, Department of Statistics (衛生福利部統計處)
description: Year-end counts of hospitals and clinics and of the licensed staff practising in them (physicians, doctors of Chinese medicine, dentists, nurses, pharmacists and others) for every township. Staff are counted where they practise, not where they live. The newest year of each dataset is used.

title: Natural-disaster losses by kind of disaster (內政統計查詢網 table c0720101)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Statistics (內政部統計處), from the National Fire Agency
description: For each year since 2000 and each kind of natural disaster (typhoons, floods, earthquakes, other): how many disasters were recorded, people killed, missing and injured, and houses destroyed or half destroyed. National figures only; the table has no money value and no county breakdown.
used_for: Disasters: national record by year and kind

title: National park visits and area (內政統計查詢網 tables c0820401, c0820101)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Statistics (內政部統計處), from the National Park Service
description: Visitors counted at the recreation sites of each national park and of the Shoushan National Nature Park in the newest complete year, and each park's land and sea area. Visits are head counts at the sites each park headquarters reports (1 to 15 sites per park), not unique visitors, so a park with more counted sites or with city streets inside it counts more.

title: Daytime and night-time population by township from mobile-network signalling (電信信令人口統計)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Statistics (內政部統計處)
description: Estimates of the people active in each township between 07:00 and 19:00 and of the people staying there at night, on weekdays and at weekends, modelled from anonymised mobile-network signalling data of November 2020. The ratio of the weekday daytime to the weekday night-time figure shows where people travel to by day (above 1) and where they only sleep (below 1).

title: Registered temples (全國宗教資訊網 寺廟登記資料)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Religious Affairs (內政部宗教及禮制司)
description: The national register of temples (寺廟): Taoist, Buddhist, I-Kuan Tao and other temples registered with local governments, each with its main deity. Counted per township, and grouped by main deity. Churches, mosques and unregistered shrines are not in this register. Names and phone numbers in the file are not used.
vintage: Temple register as downloaded (see the file's retrieval date)

title: Truck freight survey: freight moved between counties (汽車貨運調查報告 表5)
publisher: Ministry of Transportation and Communications, Department of Statistics (交通部統計處)
description: Annual sample survey of trucks (business and own-account). Table 5 of the report gives the tonnes carried by truck in the year from each county to each county (origin by destination), for the 20 counties and cities of Taiwan and Penghu; Kinmen and Lienchiang are outside the survey. Survey estimates, in metric tons (公噸); road freight only (no rail, sea or air), and no money value of the goods. The report is a PDF: the table is read from its text and checked against its own totals.
used_for: Trade routes: truck freight tonnage between counties

title: Natural Earth 1:50m (countries, lakes, rivers)
publisher: Natural Earth
description: Neighbouring countries (Canada, Mexico, Cuba, the Bahamas; shown fogged), large lakes and major rivers. Files are pinned to the natural-earth-vector release v5.1.2.

title: Natural Earth 1:10m roads and railroads
publisher: Natural Earth
description: Interstates, US highways and major state roads, and main railroads, as 1:10m line work. Shown as map art (roads and rail between hex centres), not as statistics: the road alignment dates from Natural Earth's older releases, carries no traffic or owner data, and the rail layer holds about half of the real US rail network. Files are pinned to the natural-earth-vector release v5.1.2.
used_for: Interstates and major highways on the map

title: Disaster case reports during Central Emergency Operation Center activations, 2022-2024
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, National Fire Agency (內政部消防署), Emergency Management Information Cloud
description: Every disaster case that local governments filed in the national emergency information system (EMIC) while the Central Emergency Operation Center was open for a named typhoon or earthquake: the activation, the time, the county, the township and the kind of damage (fallen trees, power cuts, flooding, damaged buildings, landslides ...). A case is a report, not a measure of damage, and how readily cases are filed differs between local governments.
used_for: Disasters: activations with reported cases, by township and county

title: Land Use Investigation 2024-2025, township statistics (113-114年國土利用現況調查成果鄉鎮市區統計資料)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, National Land Surveying and Mapping Center (內政部國土測繪中心)
description: Area of each of the 93 level-3 land-use classes in every township, from the national Land Use Investigation surveyed in 2024-2025 (2019 classification). The shares of forest, farmland and built-up land of each township are computed from it, as shares of the township's whole surveyed area.

title: National park outlines (OpenStreetMap boundary=national_park relations)
publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API
description: Outlines of Taiwan's nine national parks and the Shoushan National Nature Park as mapped in OpenStreetMap. Used for the hexes each park covers and for its centre point. The National Park Service publishes each park's plan boundary separately (some as archives a standard-library reader cannot open, some without a coordinate system), so one consistent open outline is used instead; it is not the legal boundary.
used_for: National-park wonders: position and protected hexes

title: Power plant positions (OpenStreetMap power=plant)
publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API
description: Name and centre point of every power=plant element around Taiwan in OpenStreetMap. Taipower publishes each plant's units and capacity but no coordinates, so OSM says where a plant is and nothing else: the capacities OSM mappers typed in are not read.
used_for: Positions of the power plants, dams and wind farms on the resources layer

title: Freeways, expressways, provincial highways, railways, airports and harbours (OpenStreetMap)
publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API
description: Line work of Taiwan's national freeways (國道, highway=motorway), expressways (快速公路, highway=trunk) and provincial highways (省道, highway=primary), and of the railways (railway=rail: Taiwan Railway and the High Speed Rail), as mapped in OpenStreetMap. Also the centre points of airports with an IATA code and of named harbour areas, used only to place the airports and ports whose traffic figures come from the Civil Aviation Administration and Taiwan International Ports. Roads and rail are drawn as map art between hex centres, not as statistics: OSM carries no traffic counts.
used_for: Freeways, expressways and provincial highways on the map
Positions of airports and commercial ports

title: Age, education, indigenous status and deaths by township (ODRP014, ODRP020, ODRP013, ODRP031)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Household Registration (內政部戶政司)
description: Household registration tables: residents by single year of age and sex for every village, registered education of residents aged 15 and over, indigenous status (all at the end of 2025), and deaths by single year of age and sex for every township in 2023-2025. Villages are summed to their township. The median age, the share with a university degree, the indigenous share and an age-standardised mortality ratio are computed from them.

title: Population and land area of each township, year-end (ODRP048)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, Department of Household Registration (內政部戶政司)
description: Registered population at the end of each year (2020-2025) and land area for the 368 townships and districts (鄉鎮市區). City and county totals are sums of their townships; growth compares the end of 2021 with the end of 2025 on today's boundaries.

title: SRTM15+ global relief model (V2)
publisher: Scripps Institution of Oceanography; served by NOAA NMFS SWFSC ERDDAP
license: Public domain (U.S. Government-supported research data; cite Tozer et al. 2019)
description: Land elevation and ocean depth on a 15 arc-second grid (about 460 m), for every point in the map window. Each hex's relief (flat, hills, mountains, peaks) comes from the mean and spread of the roughly 30-70 land samples inside it; sea hexes take the mean depth.

title: Generating units and installed capacity (台灣電力公司_各機組發電量)
publisher: Taiwan Power Company (台灣電力公司)
description: Taipower's system snapshot: every generating unit or unit group on the grid, by fuel class, with its installed capacity in MW and a status note, for Taipower's own plants and the independent power producers. Units are summed per plant to size the power plants, dams and wind farms on the map. The file has no coordinates (plants are placed with OpenStreetMap) and is a snapshot of the day it was fetched.
used_for: Power plants, dams, pumped storage, wind and solar farms: capacity (MW)

title: Cargo throughput of the international commercial ports (臺灣地區國際商港貨物吞吐量)
publisher: Taiwan International Ports Corporation (臺灣港務股份有限公司)
description: Monthly cargo throughput in metric tons (公噸) of the seven international commercial ports (Keelung, Taipei, Su'ao, Taichung, Kaohsiung, Anping, Hualien), split into import, export and domestic cargo, since 2001. The newest calendar year with all twelve months is summed. Industrial ports (Mailiao, Heping) and the domestic ports of the outlying islands are not in this file.
used_for: Ports: cargo tonnage, imports, exports, domestic cargo
vintage: 臺灣港務公司 國際商港貨物吞吐量，2025 年

title: County and township boundaries (TopoJSON)
publisher: Ministry of the Interior, National Land Surveying and Mapping Center (packaged by taiwan-atlas)
license: Government Open Data License v1.0 (MOI); taiwan-atlas packaging MIT
description: Outlines of the 22 counties and cities (縣市) and 368 townships and districts (鄉鎮市區), simplified TopoJSON built from the National Land Surveying and Mapping Center's boundary files. Decide which county and township each hex belongs to. Pratas and the Spratlys are outside the map.
used_for: County and township of each hex

title: Rivers of Taiwan (OpenStreetMap river relations)
publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API
description: Every named river relation (waterway=river) in the map window, main stem only. Rivers whose main stem is shorter than 15 km are left out; the rest are ranked by length (rank 1 ≥ 150 km, such as the Zhuoshui and Gaoping) and drawn thinner as they get shorter.
vintage: OpenStreetMap via Overpass (retrieved with the raw file; see manifest)

title: Coordinates of universities and colleges in Taiwan (Wikidata)
publisher: Wikidata (Wikimedia Foundation)
description: Latitude and longitude (property P625) of each higher-education institution in Taiwan, with its Chinese names. The Ministry of Education's directory gives addresses but no coordinates, so a school is placed at its Wikidata point nearest the township of its registered address; a school with several campuses has several points.
used_for: University wonders: position on the map

title: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
publisher: European Space Agency (ESA WorldCover consortium); hosted on the AWS Open Data Registry
license: CC BY 4.0. © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
description: Global land cover from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 at 10 m, read here from the 1/16 overview of the cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs (~148 m pixels). Each hex's biome (forest, farmland, grassland, wetland, built-up…) and its land-cover shares come from about 500 pixels sampled inside it.
used_for: Forest / cropland / built-up shares of each hex
